newsitem.title: USA: Delta Air Lines matches Thanksgiving sale.
newsitem.headline: Delta Air Lines matches Thanksgiving sale.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc said on Monday it will offer Thanksgiving holiday sale fares, following similar holiday fare cuts by AMR Corp's American Airlines.
Delta said holiday fares begin as low as $96 round-trip for travel on Thanksgiving Day and Friday, November 29.
The mileage-based Thanksgiving sale fares range from $96 to $196 round trip and are available between most cities within the 48 contiguous states, the company said.
The fares require no advanced purchase, but passengers must purchase their tickets with 24 hours after reservations are confirmed, the carrier said.
Travel must begin by midnight November 29, and no minimum stay is required, Delta said.
AMR Corp's sale fares range from $88 to $298 roundtrip, for flights on November 24, 25 or 28. The return part of the trip must occur November 28 or 29, AMR said.
AMR also is also offering Thanksiving holiday specials to selected international destinations in Europe, Canada, Mexico and the Caribbean with discounts up to 50 percent off regular fares.
